subject.title: Control UI: Pinned context panel for user-defined persistent facts

question: Should pinned user facts be implemented as a first-party Control UI memory feature, folded into the broader memory-file panel, or deferred behind plugin-contributed Control UI surfaces?
rationale: The request changes persistent context and sensitive user data behavior, while current main only settles whole-file editing, read-only workspace browsing, and generic plugin tabs, not storage, freshness, authorization, or injection semantics.

options.title: Keep Canonical Pinned-Facts Design
options.body: Use this issue to settle pinned-fact storage, always-injected versus last-seen labels, diff-preview, security, and injection tests before implementation.

options.title: Fold Into Memory Panel
options.body: Treat the first version as part of the broader MEMORY.md/USER.md panel if maintainers want raw memory-file editing to own the UX.

options.title: Defer To Plugin UI Seam
options.body: Wait for the Control UI plugin contribution direction if maintainers want memory/context panels to be plugin-contributed rather than bespoke core UI.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical Pinned-Facts Design
recommendation.body: Use this issue to settle pinned-fact storage, always-injected versus last-seen labels, diff-preview, security, and injection tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses root memory policy, Control UI plugin tabs, and security-sensitive context behavior where the strongest history points to steipete.
